name: confident-girl-neon-street
image_purpose: Street-style social post and urban lifestyle visual

prompt.project_info: Create a realistic full-body street-fashion portrait of an approved adult woman seated confidently on a yellow fire hydrant in a busy Asian city street.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with long straight center-parted black hair, soft natural facial features, and minimal makeup. She wears a white ribbed zip-up sweater, dark-gray wide-leg jeans, black open-toe platform sandals, and a black shoulder bag. Her expression is calm and observant as she looks to the side.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level full-body 35mm street-photography framing, seated with legs comfortably apart and arms crossed on the hydrant. Include neon Chinese shop signs, double-decker buses, yellow taxis, crowded sidewalks, tall residential buildings, and realistic street infrastructure.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft overcast natural daylight, neutral tones with vibrant urban accents, believable reflections and slight city haze, candid modern street-fashion energy.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm lens, sharp subject and detailed background, natural perspective, realistic fabric and pavement texture, subtle grain, high-detail editorial street photograph.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A realistic full-body urban street-fashion portrait of one approved adult woman with long straight center-parted black hair, soft natural features, and minimal makeup, seated confidently on a yellow fire hydrant in a busy Hong Kong-style street. She wears a white ribbed zip-up sweater, dark-gray wide-leg jeans, black open-toe platform sandals, and a black shoulder bag, looking calmly to the side with arms crossed. Neon Chinese shop signs, double-decker buses, yellow taxis, crowded sidewalks, tall residential buildings, eye-level 35mm street photography, soft overcast daylight, neutral tones with vibrant urban accents, realistic city texture and candid confidence.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, unsafe traffic exposure, distorted hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, unreadable invented text, watermark, celebrity likeness, low resolution, blur

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve approved adult identity, exact outfit, hydrant, urban vehicles, environment, and eye-level framing. The reference is replaceable with another approved adult urban portrait while retaining the same city-street logic. Explicitly define replacement identity, outfit, product, logo, environment, or typography; do not invent readable text.
